note: Charts as a seed-declared manifest (item 2 refactor). `name` is the chart id; `tag` is the [a-z]+ control-character tag nu wraps every address in, hashed into SEED.lock; `behavior` selects the normalizer/classifier/segmenter, keyed by id in engine code. Adding a chart takes THREE things, stated accurately after the router-seam repair of 2026-08-04: (1) a row here; (2) if the behavior is new, a normalizer in engine/normalize.py:_NORMALIZERS, a classifier in _CLASSIFIERS and a segmenter in engine/extract.py:_SEGMENTERS — these are DICT LITERALS edited in place; there is NO registration API, and the earlier wording 'three registered functions — no dispatch edit' overstated it; (3) a row in seed/LANGUAGES.json saying which extension enters the chart. Before (3) existed, engine/router.py keyed Lean off a hardcoded `name.endswith('.lean')`, so a fully declared chart could still have nothing route to it; engine/chart_plugin_audit.py now checks routing as well as addressing. The `correspondence` chart (added 2026-08-04) carries the base category's morphisms as CLAIMS: a correspondence is proposed through the one inlet like any other claim, addressed exactly, and the correspondence SET is derived from accepted claims — never written directly. `python` and `go` were added on 2026-08-04 as the FIRST TEST of the repaired seam: a row here, three behavior functions each, and a seed/LANGUAGES.json row — with no edit to engine/router.py. Neither moves an existing tag.

charts.note: THE LM's OWN CONCEPTUAL VOCABULARY AS A MODALITY. Every prompt this system sends performs an unextracted translation: the operator's idiolect read through the medium's priors. This chart makes that translation a declared object. Its claims are GLOSSES — one canonical sense per operator term — and they are about the INTERFACE, never about truth: engine/medium.py's firewall keeps them out of content settlement and out of K's candidate set, the same containment shape bears_on has. Behavior is `prose` because a gloss is prose; reusing it rather than minting a fourth normalizer is the seam working.
